description: A long hall with the apron on the other side of a wall of glass. The arrivals desk faces the doors under the arrivals board, and a row of bolted chairs runs along the window. The terrazzo is polished enough to show the neon in the ceiling. Baggage reclaim is west, check-in south, the apron east.

window.description: Floor-to-ceiling glass onto the apron and the runway past it. Whatever is taxiing, you see it here first.
window.name: the window wall

name: Arrivals Hall
